mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a near-term recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 217.0 combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 217.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.15%, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction starts (HOUST) above 600.0 thousand units, combined with a stable or rising real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a recovery in housing and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50.0 thousand in a month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.0%), indicates labor market weakening, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 6 months, combined with stable or rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong underlying economic momentum, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or the interaction term has a Rank IC below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
